name: Unrestricted LP333 correct p37q3 exact anneal
hypothesis: A deterministic exact-integer local search preserving the source-correct length-37 pq2-compression rows [1,3 chi_37] and [1,-3 chi_37] may reach zero combined PAF residual and produce an unrestricted Legendre pair of length 333.
evidence_unit: one 7200-second incremental integer-PAF annealing run with seed 20260727, 2000000 same-column swap proposals per restart, and the exact 74 length-37 column margins
claim_boundary: The paper's uncompression statement is conjectural, not an existence theorem. Only a serialized pair with exact zero objective that independently verifies both row sums, all 74 compression margins, and all 332 nonzero full-length combined PAF equations is a candidate. A lower score is workload evidence only.

baseline.evidence: The corrected source passes the exact compressed-seed identity: 333=37*3^2, compressed row sums one, combined energy 650, and combined PAF -18 at all 36 nonzero compressed shifts.
baseline.measurement: At fixed seed 20260727 the source-correct initial state has squared residual 87904, L1 residual 3096, and maximum absolute residual 72.

intervention.one_change: Apply the published p=37,q=3 prescribed compression to the unrestricted identity-family search: initialize 74 exact size-nine column margins, propose only opposite-sign swaps within one residue class modulo 37, and score all 166 independent full-length PAF residuals in exact integer arithmetic.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a nonzero or unaudited state

controls.name: factorization-and-seed-identity
controls.purpose: Prevent a repeated pq2 specialization error.
controls.expected: Verify 333=37*3^2; the two compressed rows have sums one, squared norms 325 each, combined energy 650, and combined PAF -18 at every nonzero shift.

controls.name: exact-margin-derivation
controls.expected: Residue zero has four negatives in each row; each other size-nine column has three or six negatives according to plus or minus 3 times the Legendre symbol modulo 37; each full row has 166 negatives.

controls.name: incremental-delta-self-test
controls.purpose: Detect an incorrect O(333) PAF update.
controls.expected: For 2000 deterministic random same-column swaps, every predicted PAF and squared objective equals a fresh O(333^2) recomputation and all 74 exact margins remain unchanged.

controls.name: independent-full-result-audit
controls.purpose: Recompute all mathematical quantities without importing the C search implementation.
controls.expected: A separate Python bit-rotation auditor recomputes both complete PAF vectors, all 74 margins, row sums, objective, L1 and maximum residual, exact compression rows, and candidate status.

controls.name: mutation-control
controls.purpose: Ensure the final verifier is sensitive inside the prescribed slice.
controls.expected: An opposite-sign same-column swap preserves the compression but is rejected by at least one full PAF equation.

controls.name: source-and-binary-pin
controls.expected: Source SHA-256 7a3bf72d06023658850d9e95ebc4d4eb0b3ba885da6d748a78abd5c297df486d and compiled binary SHA-256 db5324783ea5b6e47884b822a613b7087212a6e6bd57c7ebcb9ccfd0cae51153.

primary_metric.name: independently verified exact squared PAF residual reaches zero

terminal_outcomes.promote: The best squared residual is exactly zero and the independent full result audit verifies both rows, the prescribed length-37 compression, and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen 7200-second schedule completes with a valid independently audited nonzero best residual.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule before it writes and audits its best state.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any factorization, compressed seed identity, margin derivation, incremental delta, source pin, binary pin, stored-score, full PAF, candidate-status, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Require the exact 37-by-9 seed identity before launching.
Run only the pinned source and binary at seed 20260727 with 2000000 proposals per restart and the frozen 512-to-0.25 exponential temperature schedule.
Stop immediately at exact zero objective.
Otherwise stop at 7200 wall seconds without another seed, temperature, restart length, or cap.
Run the independent bit-rotation audit before interpreting the endpoint.
Do not promote a lower nonzero heuristic score.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, perform a second direct Legendre-pair audit, construct H668, verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, then package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the endpoint and move to a distinct exact structural mechanism rather than tuning this schedule.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interrupted state and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if the interruption is reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest factorization, margin, source, delta, serialization, or verifier defect before any target rerun.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned code, and public primary literature are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
